videos.title: Family of origin: why we stop calling our parents
videos.description: German Pie with six overseas guests on parent–child bonds — neglect, control, betrayal, and why many people heal alone. Original: 原生家庭 | 我们为什么不想要再联系父母？

notes.abstract: Six people living abroad share how their first intimate relationship — with their parents — still shapes whether they want contact, distance, or repair.
points: Your first bond with parents often becomes the template for later closeness and fear.
Neglect, put-downs, and betrayal can push adult children toward silence rather than confrontation.
Parents rarely change on demand — distance and self-healing are common responses, not failures.
Cutting physical contact does not always end the question of how to relate to them.
notes.conclusion: Listen for what each guest protects when they pull away — then notice which pattern shows up in your own family contact.
